shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy blazer at the screen-side window seat asks a question, a man in a mustard sweater sits at the door-side window seat, and a woman in an emerald blouse sits at the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in a mustard sweater leaves the door-side window seat and exits the venue, while the woman in a navy blazer speaks.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a navy blazer answers.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the conference table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
